methods.name: Coherent Change Detection (CCD) methodology
methods.summary: The CCD methodology uses multi-pass Sentinel-1 SAR interferometric pairs to calculate coherence difference and normalized coherence difference indicators. These indicators are used to identify phase decorrelation caused by landslides, with vegetation effects masked using NDVI thresholds and statistical classification (mean and standard deviation) to define landslide probability classes.
methods.verbatim: The Coherent Change Detection (CCD) methodology was applied successfully by detecting the phenomenon under study accurately, using two indicators (the coherence difference and the normalized coherence difference)... The workflow was created in the Graph Builder tool in Sentinel’s Application Platform (SNAP) software.
